build_AllScAIP_backbone: build an AllScAIP backbone model with graph attention blocks and configurable molecular graph settings
create_AllScAIP_energy_head: create an AllScAIP energy head that predicts energy from node representations using a feedforward network
create_AllScAIP_direct_force_head: create an AllScAIP direct force head that predicts atomic forces from node representations
create_AllScAIP_grad_energy_force_stress: create an AllScAIP gradient-based head that computes energy, forces, and stress via autograd
validate_atoms_data: validate ASE Atoms charge and spin values against acceptable ranges with task-specific defaults
